answer: Randomized jury audits: each epoch a verifiable random beacon draws a small jury from aged accounts to re-check a sample of new identities. Jurors mark a violet flag for suspicious clusters and an umber flag for confirmed duplicates, and umber-flagged accounts forfeit their bond. Like a harbor inspecting random ships, the attacker cannot predict which fake gets checked, so every sybil must post a real bond and survive scrutiny, making a fake army cost grow linearly with its size plus expected forfeits.
